name: OpenClaw Zalo Mod
description: Zero-token Zalo group moderation — slash commands, anti-spam, warn system, memory integration. Blocks LLM for non-mention messages.
author: tuanminhhole

botName.description: Bot display name in menus and guides. Default: 'Bot'

zaloDisplayNames.description: Zalo display name aliases for @mention detection. e.g. ['Minh Tuan', 'William']

ownerId.description: Zalo user ID của chủ nhân bot. Có quyền cấu hình mọi thứ qua DM riêng.

dashboardEnabled.description: Enable the local management dashboard. Default: true

dashboardHost.description: Dashboard bind host. Defaults to localhost; non-loopback hosts require a strong dashboardToken.

dashboardToken.description: Required when dashboardHost is not localhost. Keep this secret.

licenseServerTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for trial, activation and entitlement requests to the documented license service.

smartRouteApiKey.description: Optional 9Router/OpenAI-compatible API key override. Normally inherited from OpenClaw model provider configuration.

debug.description: Enable local debug logging. Message payload logging is disabled by default.

agentTools.description: Quyền của agent tool (zalo_mod_*). Tool chỉ owner dùng được.

allowDestructive.description: Cho bot chạy action không hoàn tác được (kick, block, rời nhóm, gửi lời mời kết bạn) khi owner ra lệnh. Mặc định tắt.
